learning_outcomes.text: The student knows basic fault conditions in electricity networks and systems.
The student knows basic protective devices in electricity networks and systems.
The student can analyze basic fault conditions in electricity networks and systems.
The student can select basic protective devices in electricity networks and systems.
The student is able to work in a group during measurements and project execution.

syllabus_topics: Computer simulation analysis of short-circuit fault conditions in a selected medium voltage network. Selection of power system protections for earth faults and high-current faults based on the simulation.
Examination of basic elements of power system protections.
Examination of directional earth fault relays.
Examination of distance protection unit of protection automation.
Examination of selectivity of low voltage protections.
Examination of digital protection automation unit for asynchronous motor.
Faults in the operation of electricity networks and systems.
Measurement circuits in power system protection automation systems.
Signal transmission via transmission links and signal processing in protection automation devices and systems.
Protection criteria and decision making in power system protection automation.
Generator and electric motor protection automation.
teaching_methods: Distance learning methods and techniques (E-learning, remote learning)
assessment_rules: Lectures are credited by successfully passing the exam. Laboratory classes are credited by passing colloquia, completing scheduled exercises, and positively passing reports. Project classes are credited by completing the project.
